0.original: Alphinaud seems satisfied that he and Watt are of one mind.

24.original: Wait inside the gate to the Ala Mhigan Quarter.

49.original: Grandad and his friends are already hard at work─the rest of us can do no less, eh?

50.original: It seems Wiscar has the Saltery's security well in hand. I, meanwhile, have discussed the next steps with Master Watt, and completed my inspection of the site.

51.original: With a little work, the vacant buildings here could be made into very presentable dwellings.

53.original: Apologies for the interruption, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, but the General would speak with you at your earliest convenience!

54.original: Do not feel obliged to wait around on my account. I will remain here to hammer out the finer details with Watt, and act as an intermediary with our business partners in Ul'dah. You should go.

55.original: General Aldynn asked that you wait for him by the main gate in the Ala Mhigan Quarter. My apologies again, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>! Fare you well!

56.original: That Alphinaud's a bright lad, isn't he? I told him what we'd need to repair the place and he tallied up the total cost on the spot─and it weren't a small number, either!

57.original: I'll ask Commander Hext to assign a squad to patrol the Saltery's harvesting and fishing spots. And I'll be sure to tell them what you told me!

58.original: Pray leave the administrative tasks to me. General Aldynn will be waiting.

59.original: I was just on my way to the Saltery─it's lucky I saw you!

60.original: Arenvald seems flustered. Something is amiss...

61.original: That took longer than I intended, but at least you know where I stand.

63.original: We may have a problem, sir.

64.original: A group of Ananta has arrived at the main gates. And I don't mean the Vira. These are <hex:021A020203>Qalyana<hex:021A020103>─the ones that summoned the primal.

65.original: They're insisting they be allowed to attend the council. Lyse is trying to reason with them, but she may need help...

66.original: Hmm... An invitation <hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103> extended to all of the native beast tribes...but we assumed the Qalyana would refuse it out of hand.

67.original: We had best go and see for ourselves. Pipin, take command of our forces and be ready for battle.

68.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─you've dealt with these Qalyana before. I'd have you at my side.

69.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Raubahn! Gods, it's good to see you...

71.original: We have not forgotten how you sssinned againssst the Lady of Blisss...but we did not come here to shed blood.

72.original: You claim to ssseek harmony with all who call Gyr Abania home. If thisss is truly your wish, you will welcome usss as envoys of the Ananta!

73.original: It <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> our wish, and you <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> welcome. But we cannot condone the summoning of primals.

74.original: If you want to enter the palace, I must ask that you first surrender any crystal jewelry. You have my word that it will all be returned to you when the meeting is over.

75.original: ...We will do as you asssk─but you will not have our weapons. We are not ssso foolish as to place ourssselves <hex:021A020203>entirely<hex:021A020103> at the mercy of our tormentors...

76.original: I reckon that's the closest we're going to get to a compromise. And we <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> have people standing guard...

77.original: Aye, let them keep their swords.

78.original: Then we have an agreement. Lead the way to your meeting chamber.

79.original: Why do I have the feeling we've welcomed a viper into our midst...?
